title: Technical Services Specialist
desc:
As a
Technical Services Specialist,
you will provide technical support, corrective maintenance, repair, and servicing of Stryker medical devices used in hospitals and clinics across Türkiye. Based in our Istanbul office, you will spend approximately 70% of your time travelling to customer sites to ensure our products are functioning safely, reliably, and in line with Stryker standards.
This is a great opportunity to build your technical expertise within a global medical technology company. Gain exposure to a range of Stryker technologies and customer environments.
What will you do?
Perform fault detection, troubleshooting, repair, and corrective maintenance of Stryker products at customer sites and the Istanbul office.
Test and verify equipment following repairs and complete accurate service and test reports.
Perform upgrades, preventive maintenance, and calibrations on Stryker devices as required.
Support the installation, commissioning, and servicing of equipment at hospitals and clinics.
Provide technical support to customers, service partners, and internal teams to resolve product issues.
Maintain accurate service, repair, and equipment records in the relevant systems.
Monitor spare parts requirements and communicate critical inventory needs to the relevant team.
Handle customer feedback and complaints in line with Stryker's quality and service procedures.
What will you need?
Required:
Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering or a related technical field.
0–2 years of relevant experience; previous experience in a technical, engineering, medical device, or field service environment is an advantage.
Fluent English and Turkish, written and spoken.
Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Strong interpersonal skills including written and oral communication
Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Valid driving licence and willingness to travel approximately 70% across Türkiye.
Preferred:
Previous experience with medical devices, healthcare technology, or technical field service.
Exposure to troubleshooting, repair, maintenance, installation, or calibration of technical equipment.
Knowledge of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or biomedical systems.
Location:
Istanbul, Türkiye
Travel:
Approximately 70% across Türkiye
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.
